Commit directly onto the current branch; the orchestrator handles branching/PR. Keep the bridge CSV signal contract unchanged (timestamp,symbol,action,confidence,sl_pips,tp_pips,lot_size,model_name,regime) so the .mq5 EAs keep working; model_name should carry a rule-based label such as 'momentum'.
key_patterns: Direction is decided by MOMENTUM (close vs N bars back) + RSI filter, never by model predictions (per SignalGenerator docstring). The ensemble only produced a 'confidence' number gating entry timing. backtest.py already implements the full rule-based engine WITHOUT importing any ML model: momentum direction, RSI zone filter, price-structure/EMA/ATR confidence boosts, session detection, progressive trailing stops, and a compute_momentum_magnitude() synthetic-confidence function (0.2 + 0.7*(1-exp(-abs_diff/1.5)), capped 0.95). AutoOptimizer (strategies/auto_optimizer.py) is the self-tuning mechanism: records each closed trade with context, groups by parameter value every N trades, shifts toward the winning value (clamped, one step per cycle), persists to auto_optimizer_state.json, rolls back on regression. backtest.py already instantiates and feeds it; main.py wires it to SignalGenerator via set_auto_optimizer.
